periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Primary axis of the visible eye patch is oriented at approximately a 45-degree angle downward relative to the facial midline.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval with a length-to-width ratio of approximately 2:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering toward the muzzle, creating a teardrop-shaped inferior margin.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shaped posterior edge with a smooth, continuous curve across the dorsal midline.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Relatively thick, occupying approximately 25% of the visible torso length at the lateral intersection.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide gap between pinnae, measuring roughly 1.5 to 2 times the width of a single ear base.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, rounded semi-circular apex with no visible flattening or irregularities.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced yellowish-brown tinting across the posterior dorsal and lumbar white fur regions, contrasting with the cleaner white fur of the cervical region.
